device_entry.name: CANalyst-II USB转CAN总线分析仪
tags: CAN总线通信记录与离线分析
device_entry.description: 一种通过USB连接计算机的CAN总线分析与通信适配器，可用于发送、接收和监测CAN报文。在实验室中常用于嵌入式控制器、车载电子和工业设备的CAN网络联调、协议验证与故障排查。
device_entry.description_en: A USB-connected CAN bus analysis and communication adapter used to send, receive, and monitor CAN frames. In laboratories it is commonly used for CAN network integration, protocol validation, and troubleshooting of embedded controllers, automotive electronics, and industrial equipment.
